study_identification_part.si4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract states the aim to investigate deviations in subcortical volumes in MS patients by integrating deep-learning segmentation (SynthSeg) with normative modeling to better characterize MS progression. This describes both the research objective and the purpose of applying normative modeling (disease understanding/progression characterization).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "This study ... investigate deviations in subcortical volumes in MS patients ... By comparing subcortical volumes of 326 MS patients to a normative model from 37,407 healthy individuals, we identify significant deviations that enhance our understanding of MS progression."
